_how_to_add: Append one object per gift, in the order the Gift Finds Daily videos are posted (oldest first; #1 stays first). Fields: asin (Amazon ASIN, link gets tag theworthguide20-20 automatically), name, icon (one emoji for the placeholder card; no Amazon images), line (short, hedged, factual: no prices, no specs the listing or brand does not state), posted (YYYY-MM-DD video date). Then run python3 _src/build.py.

gifts.name: Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle, 24 oz
gifts.line: Sip through the built-in straw or tilt it back to drink from the spout. The push-button lid locks shut, and Owala says it keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours. Some colors sell out, so check what the listing has before you order.
